svg.title: TARGET / PROPOSED PILOT: Foundry IQ and native Teams, two isolated officers
svg.desc: AadiK and AndreL upload synthetic PDFs through Azure Portal into separate pending Blob containers. Proposed independent approval precedes separate approved sources, Search services and Foundry IQ knowledge bases. Native Teams Activity routes connect to separate Foundry projects and managed identities. Cross-domain access must deny. Only source Storage, VNet and Blob private endpoint/DNS are deployed; other capabilities and security controls are unverified.
svg.text: Tax officer case chat | Foundry IQ + native Teams
TARGET / PROPOSED PILOT • Caldova commercial tenant • East US 2 • Synthetic case PDFs only
Microsoft Entra ID + protected server configuration
Trusted tenant + caller select the officer project and data domain; missing / unknown identity -> DENY.
Prompts, filenames, index / partition selectors and opaque caller headers are NOT authorization.
No PDF, prompt or answer bodies; native logging must be validated.
PILOT A — AadiK | isolated source, retrieval, agent permissions and history
Officer A • separate Search security domain
Separate Search service baseline; cost / quota / SKU NOT approved
ON TOP OF Azure AI Search
Dedicated ingestion identity A: read ONLY own approved source.
No blanket source or Search data rights; no naming-only isolation.
Native Foundry project / prompt agent A
Project managed identity A -> own KB / Search only
Managed-identity MCP connection to Foundry IQ
Officer-specific agent permissions and chat history
Answers / citations stay inside the officer domain
Other Foundry APIs and private tools stay private
Trusted identity + protected mapping -> ONLY officer A's authorized native project.
History / answer / citation authorization and end-to-end identity propagation require proof.
PILOT B — AndreL | isolated source, retrieval, agent permissions and history
Officer B • separate Search security domain
Separate Search service baseline; cost / quota / SKU NOT approved
ON TOP OF Azure AI Search
Dedicated ingestion identity B: read ONLY own approved source.
No blanket source or Search data rights; no naming-only isolation.
Native Foundry project / prompt agent B
Project managed identity B -> own KB / Search only
Managed-identity MCP connection to Foundry IQ
Officer-specific agent permissions and chat history
Answers / citations stay inside the officer domain
Other Foundry APIs and private tools stay private
Trusted identity + protected mapping -> ONLY officer B's authorized native project.
History / answer / citation authorization and end-to-end identity propagation require proof.
DENY A -> B / DENY B -> A: Blob • ingestion identities • KB / Search • agent answers • history • citations (required, not yet tested)
Private processing / outbound connectivity • TARGET, NOT PROVEN
Required: Foundry + Search private endpoints / private DNS AND supported outbound runtime connectivity.
Existing VNet + Blob private endpoint / DNS do not prove Foundry / Search runtime connectivity.
Native private Blob knowledge-source mode: documented for S2 / S3 / L1 / L2; SKU selection remains unapproved.
Search shared private links -> source / model endpoints are DIFFERENT from ordinary inbound private endpoints.
Approval / source-version correctness • independent release gate
Native IQ does NOT prove independent approval, exact-source checks or revocation.
Indexing is asynchronous; freshness and immediate revocation are NOT guaranteed.
Blob versioning is incompatible with native indexer soft-delete policy.
Validate supported lifecycle / deletion strategy and authoritative checks before release.
Processing identities need approved, narrowly scoped data rights.
Conceptual shared Foundry / model parent only; parent resource details still being finalized.
Existing AIServices account: no models, projects or agents. Native Teams is not deployed.
No Search, Foundry IQ, Logic Apps or APIM deployed.
Source roles + Teams TEAMS1 configured; live cross-user access tests remain pending.
Prove cross-officer denial, citation access, private runtime and metadata-only logging.
Validate the two-officer pattern before eventual expansion to ten officers.
OPTIONAL APIM • only for a genuinely required private tool / approval API
Not deployed; NOT in the native Teams route; NOT required for a Foundry private endpoint.
Inbound private endpoint ≠ outbound VNet integration; neither grants private management-client access.
Source Storage + officer-a-pending / officer-b-pending + VNet + Blob PE / DNS.
Public HTTPS network enabled; anonymous Blob and shared keys disabled. All other flows are targets.
No customer-hosted chat bridge or upload application. No PDF upload via Teams, agent, APIM or an application endpoint.
Solid foundation boundaries indicate existing source/network assets only, not verified permissions. All isolation and lifecycle controls require end-to-end acceptance tests.
